title: Keto Thanksgiving Board
seo_title: Keto Thanksgiving Charcuterie Board: Light Appetizer Plan
description: A keto Thanksgiving appetizer board for 10: cheddar, Gruyère, goat cheese, smoked turkey, prosciutto, celery, radishes, pecans and sage. About 4 g net carbs a serving.
hook: A light start before the big meal: a keto appetizer board for ten that won't ruin anyone's appetite.
why: Before Thanksgiving dinner, the board should take the edge off hunger without filling anyone up. This one is portioned as a starter: smoked turkey breast, prosciutto and salami with cheddar, Gruyère and a log of goat cheese.

Celery, cucumbers and radishes are the dippers, pecans and blackberries add fall flavor, and fresh sage leaves make it look like the holiday. At about 4 g net carbs per serving, it's the lowest-carb board in the book.

timeline.what: Take out the cheddar and Gruyère.
Take out the goat cheese; roll the log in chopped pecans if you like.
Take out the meats; roll the turkey.
Serve, and put it away when dinner starts.

faq.q: What's a good keto Thanksgiving appetizer?
faq.a: A small board of aged cheddar, Gruyère and goat cheese, smoked turkey and prosciutto, celery, radishes, olives, mustard, pecans and blackberries.

faq.q: How much charcuterie for Thanksgiving appetizers?
faq.a: About 1½ to 2 oz each of cheese and meat per guest when dinner follows.
About 4 g net carbs per serving for 10.
